summary: Verified duplicate-title + narrow-width bug fix on /partner?tab=subscriptions (web panel) and ran all listed regressions. All checks pass. Screenshots at /app/test_reports/partner_subs_maid_1920.png and /app/test_reports/partner_subs_detail_1920.png confirm single 'Maid Subscriptions' page title and full-width 3-column card grid.
critical_code_review_comments: PartnerSubscriptions.jsx is clean (~226 lines). Panel header is authoritative source of the title; component starts with w-full and responsive grids (sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3) for cards and upcoming strip. Detail view uses lg:grid-cols-2 for cards and md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 for daily schedule.

'Upcoming work · next 7 days' strip is conditional on upcoming.length > 0 — in current seed data most schedules end today so the strip was not rendered during the list view test; this is expected behavior, not a bug.
